page.description: BigLinux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Brazilian community Linux distribution shipping x86_64 live/install ISOs with KDE Plasma. Three kernel variants for hardware compatibility. Rolling/dated build model — no fixed release-number scheme.
pros: Three kernel variants (6.12, 6.18 recommended, 7.2 TKG) for broad hardware support
KDE Plasma 6 desktop fully customised for gaming and daily use
cons: MD5 is the only published digest — not cryptographically strong
Download version list is JavaScript-driven on the main page
No EOL or support-window date published
The publisher lists MD5 only, and each ISO is 5.1 GiB, so no SHA-256 is offered here.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for BigLinux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write any of the three kernel variant ISOs to a USB stick (≥8 GB) with Ventoy, Etcher or UNetbootin. Boot from the stick and use the graphical installer. On some hardware Secure Boot may need disabling.
